errors.text_span: typically shows the lowest negative log-probability (highest value on the y-axis)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the fine-tuned model for the same specialty shows the 'lowest negative log-probability'. According to the y-axis, which ranges from -27 to -22, the highest bar corresponds to the highest numerical value (least negative), which is the highest negative log probability, not the lowest. The sentence contradicts itself by equating 'lowest negative log-probability' with 'highest value on the y-axis'.
